title: Use ETag cache for upcoming mixshow events with query params
description: Support addictune_cli issue ADD-3fh by making `MixShowsAPI.get_upcoming(limit=...)` use the SDK cache path. It currently calls HTTP directly even though the live-shows service polls this endpoint repeatedly.
design: Extend the existing cached list helper minimally to accept request parameters and use the complete request URL as the cache key when parameters are present; call it from get_upcoming with `limit`.
acceptance_criteria: `get_upcoming(limit=...)` preserves the current public signature and typed output while sending `limit` through the cached list helper; cache keys distinguish distinct parameter sets; focused tests cover request parameters and ETag/304 behavior.
close_reason: Extended cached_get_list with query parameter cache keys and routed MixShowsAPI.get_upcoming(limit=...) through it; added coverage for parameterized keys and cached 304 responses.

title: Expose asset download and stream playlist resolution through SDK
description: Support addictune_cli issues ADD-sz2 and ADD-baz by moving its remaining AudioAddict/CDN HTTP operations into this SDK. The CLI currently downloads image bytes with its own httpx client and synchronously resolves PLS/M3U stream playlists with urllib. Provide minimal async SDK operations that reuse the SDK HTTP client and existing network-scoped channel flow.
design: Expose a root-level asset byte download operation for externally supplied artwork URLs and add async playlist URL resolution to ChannelsAPI, since playlist URLs are produced by the network-scoped channel API. Parse only PLS/M3U/M3U8 formats already used by the CLI; return non-playlist URLs unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: SDK clients can asynchronously fetch raw artwork bytes through a public namespace; ChannelsAPI asynchronously resolves absolute PLS and M3U/M3U8 URLs and leaves direct stream URLs unchanged; HTTP errors use existing typed SDK error handling; tests cover PLS, M3U relative URL resolution, direct URL passthrough, configured network independence, and asset bytes.
close_reason: Added unauthenticated client.assets.get_bytes() for artwork and async ChannelsAPI.resolve_stream_url() for PLS/M3U/M3U8 resolution, with a separate public-content client to avoid sending API session headers to CDN/listen hosts and focused tests.

title: Add network-scoped multi-entity search API to the SDK
description: Implement search as an AudioAddict network feature, exposed through `client.network(slug).search`, never through a hardcoded DI.FM route. The initial endpoint observed in the HAR is `GET /{network}/search?q=...` returning category buckets for channels, shows, playlists, and tracks with totals and typed items.
design: Add a small `SearchAPI` namespace configured with the existing `NetworkClient` slug and a generic Pydantic search bucket/envelope model that reuses existing domain models. Support only the observed `q` parameter; leave unverified filters, pagination, and search-only entity enrichment to follow-up investigation.
acceptance_criteria: `client.network("di").search` and at least one other configured network construct requests as `/{network}/search` with no hardcoded station slug; a non-empty query validates into typed channel/show/playlist/track buckets with `total` metadata; query validation rejects blank search terms; tests cover namespace wiring, request parameters, and grouped model validation; public exports and concise README usage are added; no credentials from captured traffic are committed.
notes: Scoped down to the verified minimal contract at implementation time. Search-only response fields and additional API parameters remain intentionally unmodeled pending addictune-sdk-8qm.
close_reason: Implemented minimal network-scoped SearchAPI and typed grouped response model using only confirmed q parameter; exposed through NetworkClient and exports; documented usage; unit tests cover grouped validation, configured-network routing, blank terms, and namespace wiring.

title: Characterize AudioAddict multi-entity search contract across networks
description: Investigate the `/v1/{network}/search` endpoint before fixing the public SDK contract. The supplied DI.FM HAR proves `q` and an envelope with `channels`, `shows`, `playlists`, and `tracks`, but does not prove behavior for other AudioAddict networks, non-empty channel/track result shapes, authentication requirements, pagination/limits, or optional search parameters. Capture or query sanitized examples without committing session keys or other credentials.
design: Test multiple configured network slugs through the same network-scoped path pattern; capture result examples for each populated entity bucket and responses where totals exceed returned item counts. Treat additional filters, paging, and anonymous availability as unsupported until observed.
acceptance_criteria: Document confirmed request parameters, authentication behavior, limit/pagination behavior, and cross-network URL behavior; add sanitized response fixtures or recorded field inventories covering non-empty channel, show, playlist, and track buckets when obtainable; explicitly identify any contract elements still unproven.

title: Prevent duplicate pages from SDK pagination
description: Guard shared API pagination against an endpoint returning the same full entity page repeatedly, as observed when loading followed mixshows. The SDK should avoid duplicate yielded rows and terminate when pagination produces no new entity identifiers.
acceptance_criteria: Shared pagination yields unique id-bearing entities across overlapping pages; a completely repeated full page terminates iteration; focused unit tests cover both repeated and partially overlapping pages.
close_reason: Added identifier-based pagination deduplication and repeated-page termination with unit coverage.

title: Add default TTL for ETag cache entries with no/expired server TTL
description:
## Problem

When the server returns `Cache-Control: max-age=0` (or `max-age` ≤ `age`), the SDK computes `ttl=None`. The `cache.set_etag()` function stores entries with no expiration when `ttl=None`, meaning they persist **forever** in the SQLite cache with no cleanup.

This affects any endpoint returning `max-age=0` or no `Cache-Control` — the ETag cache stores entries with no `exp` value, so `DELETE_EXPIRED` never cleans them up.

## Solution

1. Add a `default_cache_ttl` setting to `AddictuneConfig` (300 seconds / 5 minutes).
2. In `_helpers.py`, when `rh.ttl` is `None` (server sent `max-age=0` or no cache-control), fall back to `default_cache_ttl` instead of storing with no expiration.
3. ~~Convert `playlists.get_content()` from bare POST to ETag-cached~~ — dropped, POST caching is semantically wrong.

## Files changed
- `config.py` — add `default_cache_ttl: int = 300` to `AddictuneConfig`
- `cache.py` — add `set_default_ttl()` and `resolve_ttl()`
- `client.py` — propagate `default_cache_ttl` to cache module
- `api/_helpers.py` — use `cache.resolve_ttl(rh.ttl)` instead of raw `rh.ttl`

title: Add popular mixshow listing endpoint
description: Implement the DI.FM show browser's popular listing captured in www.di.fm5.har. The API uses /shows/index ordered by active and follows_count rather than a channel-filter object endpoint; expose it through MixShowsAPI and retain list-response fields needed by consumers.
design: Do not unify ChannelsAPI.get_filter and mixshow popularity behind one resource-level method because the upstream response contracts differ. Reuse the existing paginate request/caching helper.
acceptance_criteria: MixShowsAPI can iterate popular shows through /{network}/shows/index with order_by active and follows_count; returned MixShow models expose captured popularity/list fields; unit tests validate URL, query parameters, and model parsing; documentation shows usage and explains that this is ordering rather than ChannelFilter.

title: Add follow and unfollow mixshow API methods
description: Implement authenticated mixshow follow/unfollow operations exposed by the AudioAddict API, using the endpoint behavior captured in the provided HAR and matching the existing channel favorite API style.
acceptance_criteria: MixShowsAPI exposes follow and unfollow methods using /members/{user_id}/followed_items/show/{show_id}; success and API error behavior are unit tested; public models remain consistent with endpoint response shapes.
close_reason: Implemented mixshow follow/unfollow API methods with tests in commit f8faa71.

title: Add channel filter endpoint models
description: Expose AudioAddict channel_filters API in the SDK with typed models and unit coverage.
close_reason: Added ChannelsAPI.get_filter() with ChannelFilter model and unit coverage.

title: Enrich mixshow episode SDK model
description: Add missing fields returned by mixshows.get_upcoming() to the SDK Pydantic ShowEpisode model so API payloads are preserved.
close_reason: Added missing ShowEpisode fields and test coverage.
